$comment: DECISIONS §21 Q23 — this repo dogfoods its own manifest, so a Kairoku daemon can run the CLI repo's own plan items. The daemon reads this file from origin/main, never from a run's worktree. `.kairoku/rules/` is picked up automatically (§21's lead ruling): no entry here asks for it, because a repo must not be able to opt its own gate out in the same file the gate reads.
